facts.fact: Michele 恨学校；九月对他等于死亡：海滨小镇空了、点心变冷、丧钟宣布新学年。
facts.anchor: He hates school more than anything else, and the whole year revolves around it.

facts.fact: 一月六日早晨 Michele 在客厅看见父亲裤子上着火，母亲用父亲送她的绿披肩扑灭。
facts.anchor: The first thing he sees is a flame on Papa’s trousers.

facts.fact: 父亲发抖、低声叫，地上有没熄的烟；Michele 叫他毫无反应，他对母亲说父亲连他都不认得了。
Michele 的得意被愧疚冲掉（披肩毁了），但他不道歉，因为「在父母面前必须坚强」。
facts.anchor: And the triumph is swept away by guilt, as he thinks how this morning has cost Mama even that little token of love

facts.fact: 同一早晨罗马的孩子全醒着，San Basilio 街上一个富家孩子六点被发现死亡，另一个被打得可能再也走不了路。
facts.anchor: The children are awake and not one of them is dreaming—but that is not why wonder dies.

facts.fact: Giovanni 与 Luisa 在地下室做爱后吃早餐；他在分析 172 张打哈欠照片写论文，导师 Fatty 说他的题目只是文学母题。
facts.anchor: The differences in yawning posture in the generation of the ’70s and ’80s, and all the political implications. I still have 172 photos of yawns to analyse.

facts.fact: Luisa 警告他别把自己扔掉；Giovanni 沉默喝完牛奶，说服自己哈欠比他的传说、比 Neverland 更有意思。
facts.anchor: He finishes his milk in silence, trying to convince himself that yawns really are an intriguing subject, more so than his legend. More than Neverland.

facts.fact: Luca 被陌生人处理伤口，父亲带着妻子与小儿子 Renzo 到场；他问 Giulio，得到的口气意味着 Giulio 死了；一个小个子男人问话，他逐字复述「Tell them he’s coming back」，对方没听懂。
facts.anchor: “Tell them he’s coming back,” Luca repeats, word for word.

numbers.anchor: Waking on the morning of the 6th of January, Michele thinks about the vortex.
I still have 172 photos of yawns to analyse.
Within these thirty square metres, only two light fittings work
if not for the forty watts from the bedside lamp

numbers.value: 三年（Luisa 牵他跨过性与爱之间的深渊）
numbers.anchor: three years ago Luisa took Giovanni by the hand and guided him across it

relations.note: Silvia（Mama）是 Stefano 的妻子、Michele 的母亲，全天照顾病人。
relations.anchor: “Easy, Stefi,” she says, now speaking in her soothing voice.

relations.note: Luisa 是 Giovanni 的女友；Fatty Bolger 是他的导师兼论文合作者。
relations.anchor: It was Luisa who first gave Giovanni’s supervisor a nickname based on a hobbit

relations.anchor: their younger son—fucking Renzo who doesn’t even pretend to cry
